verdict.rationale: Skyfire lets sellers gate access by identity level via KYA verification (token creation fails if a buyer isn't verified to the required level) and lets sellers set required identity/service parameters and IP restrictions, which functions as a coarse allow/deny mechanism. However there is no documented per-agent or per-platform allow/deny list, and no rate-limiting controls for merchants — missing for 10: explicit rate-limit configuration, granular per-agent/platform block or allow lists, dashboard controls for denying specific known agents.
